text:
anika_kapoor: Hey team — scheduling the Kestrel Private deployment review call. Two candidate slots: Wed Mar 25 17:00 PT / 01:00 UTC and Thu Mar 26 09:00 PT / 17:00 UTC. Proposed agenda:
1) Quick rollout rundown (5m)
2) Infra prerequisites: VPC peering, firewall, routes (10m)
3) Security: KMS/HSM + certs (10m)
4) Runbook & rollback steps (10m)
5) Canary plan and metrics to watch (10m)
6) Open Qs + owners (5m)
Please reply with which slot works, who can own each bullet, and attach any prechecks. I can host the call and send calendar invite once we lock attendees. Also: need a contact from Kestrel and a short network test doc before the call. :calendar: 

tom_lin: first slot conflicts for me (all-hands). Thu morning (second slot) is fine if we keep it to 45m. Can @maria_gomez own canary + SLO checks? I'll own VPC peering / firewall checklist.

maria_gomez: I can take canary and SLO verification. Thu works. I'll run a smoke canary in staging beforehand and share baseline numbers. Can someone drop the expected IP ranges and the target endpoints so I can script the checks?

leo_choi: Thu works for me too. Quick Q: do we need a KMS/HSM test decrypt during the call or just a preflight? I can run a test decrypt against the staging key if you give me the key alias and an endpoint. Also need the Kestrel SOC contact (email/phone) for post-cutover validation.

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: Kestrel Private Deployment Review — Thu Mar 26 09:00 PT (invite pending accept). Organizer: anika_kapoor.

anika_kapoor: Thanks — locking Thu Mar 26 09:00 PT. Attendees: @anika_kapoor, @tom_lin, @maria_gomez, @leo_choi + Kestrel contact TBD. Prep checklist (please update the doc before EOD Wed): <https://redwood.tools/runbooks/kestrel-private-rollout-prep>
Required prechecks: 
- VPC peering status: peering-id + route tables synced
- Firewall: allow inbound IPs: 10.40.0.0/16, 35.212.100.0/24, 34.83.45.0/24
- TLS certs: certs deployed to LB and expiry > 30 days
- KMS test: decrypt successful with alias:alias/kestrel-staging-key
- Runbook PR: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/infra-runbooks/pull/842 (please review)

Network test snippet to run from customer side or our bastion:
```
# quick HTTP health test
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://kestrel-internal.example.com/health || echo "network failed"
```

KMS decrypt test (example):
```
aws kms decrypt --region us-west-2 --ciphertext-blob fileb://cipher.bin --output text --query Plaintext | base64 --decode
```

If you can all add owners next to each checklist item in the runbook, I will send the calendar invite + meeting notes template.

tom_lin: I'll add owners for peering + firewall and verify route tables. Ping me on the PR when done, I'll do a security review. Also can someone ping @security for a quick cert sanity check?

maria_gomez: I'll review PR #842 today and post canary baseline numbers in the runbook (metrics: p50/p95 latency, error rate, token cost). I will also do an AV/video check before the call and record.

leo_choi: I'll perform the KMS test and drop results in the runbook. Also I'll ask Kestrel for the SOC contact — @tom_lin can you share the contact alias you have?

anika_kapoor: @tom_lin I have an intro thread but need the direct phone — if you can forward that that'd be great. Also note: plan for a 30-min immediate rollback window post-cutover, and a 2-hour longer observation for metrics.

maria_gomez: Ack. I'll be the on-call for the first 2 hours after cutover.

tom_lin: Sharing contact via DM. I've also added a checklist item to run `traceroute` from their peering CIDR to our bastion: `traceroute -n 35.212.100.45`.

anika_kapoor: Great. Last asks before EOD Wed: 1) everyone add owners in the runbook link, 2) run the network test and paste results, 3) @maria_gomez please post canary baseline. If anything is blocked, post here ASAP. Otherwise I'll send the invite + meeting notes template in the morning. :rocket:
